ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth personal security agent that detects phishing emails and malicious network anomalies using local LLMs and prompt-injection hardening.
ideas.title: SecuraGuard Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the defensive cybersecurity workshop and anomaly detection focus of Secura.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated community and alert-sharing portal where verified security analysts can share threat intel without leaking infrastructure details.
ideas.title: ZeroTrust Stoa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced defensive concepts with ZK-gating, mimicking successful privacy-preserving hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: A governable, jam-resilient cooperative edge threat detector that spots network anomalies and keeps human-in-the-loop validation off the automated kill chain.
ideas.title: Aegis-Edge Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves technically difficult defensive engineering challenges relevant to real-time incident response.

ideas.pitch: An AI platform specifically designed to detect, explain, and mitigate bias and false-positive anomalies in automated cybersecurity classification systems.
ideas.title: FairThreat ML Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses false positives, a major pain point in threat detection that judges care about.

ideas.pitch: An offline acoustic and radio mesh network tool for ultra-fast communication and incident alert propagation during simulated cybersecurity blackouts.
ideas.title: EchoMesh Incident Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features unusual physical or offline networking builds that stand out in a room full of standard web applications.
